enchantments.tooltip: Dexterity +13: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +13 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Armor Bonus +13: This item surrounds the wearer with an invisible but tangible field of force, granting +13 armor bonus to AC, just as though he were wearing armor.
Parrying +6: +6 Insight bonus to Armor Class, +6 Insight bonus to Saves.
Protection +11: Passive: +11 Deflection bonus to Armor Class.
Legacy of Tharne: While wearing two pieces from the Legacy of Tharne set, you gain:+15% Artifact bonus to Doublestrike and Doubleshot+3 Sneak Attack Dice+5 Artifact bonus to Spot and Search
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
